summary: Cavalry and trade civ. Royal Knights arrive in Feudal, the Town Center works faster each age, and economic upgrades are cheap.

spikes.label: Royal Knight rush
spikes.detail: Royal Knights in Feudal hit hard on the charge and raid villagers.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and a tower near your gold. Keep villagers close to safe spots.

spikes.label: Arbalétriers and knights
spikes.detail: Arbalétriers and Royal Knights together beat most mixed armies in Castle.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and Men-at-Arms, with a few crossbows.

spikes.label: Royal Cannons
spikes.detail: Royal Cannons and Ribauldequins are cheaper in gold this patch and break armies and buildings.
spikes.answer: Kill the siege with cavalry or Men-at-Arms.
